parsed.rationale: Both participating records have is_test=true: 'iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession' in Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift and 'EntityResolverMockWebSession' in Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsAPIEntityResolverCachingTests.swift. Although they share the 'requestedURLs:[URL]' field and a broadly similar mock-session shape, the differing 'responses' slot ([Data] vs [String: Data]) reflects genuinely different stubbing contracts required by their respective test suites. Extracting a shared PAT into production-visible code would pollute non-test targets with test infrastructure, and the structural overlap is insufficient to justify a shared test-only abstraction across two unrelated packages.
